jobs.title: Apprentice
jobs.description:
**Who we are looking for**

Our program is designed for Apprentices to gain valuable experiences alongside on\-the\-job training both technically and professionally towards becoming our future leaders and technology experts. You’ll learn from some of the most respected highly qualified people in the industry and be supported by individual mentors and development programs.


The role requires attention to detail and good understanding of coding, design, development of applications and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies. Our Apprentices will get an opportunity to work with State Street Technology Services at Hyderabad and Bangalore office locations.


**Why this role is important to us**

Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence, and robotics process automation. We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end\-to\-end, next\-generation financial services company.


Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems, and make your mark on our industry.


**What you will be responsible for**

As an Apprentice you will be :


* Analyzing the business/ technical requirement documents
* Contributing to the application design, development, testing and deployment
* Participating in agile team meetings such as Stand\-up calls and retrospective meetings
* Preparing the technical documentation required for adopted SDLC process.
* Collaborating with various State Street internal teams
* Develop and maintain applications with Java and SQL.
* Knowledge of HTML/CSS/JavaScript
* Cloud Computing \- Understand IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, NaaS and other AWS \& Azure Cloud Computing Fundamentals
* DevOps – CI/CD concepts, Jenkins, Git, GitHub, Jenkins, Harness
* Monitoring Tools \- Splunk/Dynatrace \& Grafana for Presentation/Dashboards
* Site Reliability Engineering, ITIL Process (Ticketing \& Project Management Tools \- Service Now \& Jira /Confluence )
* Database, Middleware, Storage, Windows, Unix operating environment concepts
* Automation Tools/Languages (R, Python, Ansible (AAAS), RPA \- Blue Prism), Django for automation of N/w configurations

**What we value**

These skills will help you succeed in this role:


* Combination of academic aptitude, analytical capabilities, and excellent communication
* Strong critical thinking, problem solving and decision\-making skills.
* Display a culture of individual ownership of tasks to embed a clear individual sense of accountability in performing the role.
* Ensure that the highest level of the Code of Conduct is displayed in your behavior.
* Support the ‘Risk Excellence’ culture within the business.
* Adhere to limits of delegation and escalation procedures required by your manager so that you comply with internal policies and external regulations.

**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**

* B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA degree or equivalent or related field
* Working knowledge and skills in GUI development with Java middle and databases back\-end to create an end\-to\-end solution desirable.
* Understanding software development lifecycle and software development common practices (code reviews, unit testing etc.)
* Good understanding of SQL performance tuning techniques including query plan understanding and management, SQL tracing, DB stats, indexing techniques etc., highly preferred
* Good in managing and resolving problems on a live production system.

**About State Street**

**What we do.** State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data \& analytics, investment research \& trading and investment management to institutional clients.


**Work, Live and Grow.** We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance, and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.


**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.** We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.


State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.


Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers

jobs.title: Social Media, Brand & Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**

We are one of the UK's leading suppliers of porcelain paving, natural stone, sandstone, limestone, wall cladding and outdoor and indoor living products. We sell to homeowners, landscapers, garden designers and trade customers across the UK, through our own website and through major marketplaces.

It is a visual business. People do not buy a slab, they buy the garden it becomes. Every photograph, video, email and post we publish either helps someone picture that or wastes their time.

Our Hyderabad office works directly with UK leadership across marketing, ecommerce and operations.

**The role**

You will own how the brand looks, sounds and shows up everywhere a customer meets us: social media, email, affiliate, influencer and brand partnerships, all brand and product visual assets, and product content across our website and marketplaces.

This is a hands\-on creative role. You will make the work yourself: photography, product and social imagery, graphics, product presentation and display across every channel, and the copy that goes with it. Video and motion content is produced in house by our full time AI motion graphics specialist, who you will work closely with.

You will report directly to the Head of Growth Marketing \& Strategy and work daily with UK leadership.

**What you will own1\. Social media**

* Own every social channel end to end: strategy, calendar, creative, publishing and community.
* Produce the imagery yourself: product and lifestyle stills, carousels, stories, graphics and before and after transformations. Brief and direct our motion graphics specialist on the video and reels each channel needs, then publish and optimise them.
* Build a content engine around customer projects, installations, product launches, seasonal moments and the UK landscaping year.
* Manage the community. Answer comments, questions and direct messages quickly, and route genuine sales enquiries to the right person. In our category a single message can be a five figure order.
* Grow followers, engagement and, most importantly, traffic and enquiries that turn into revenue.

**2\. Email marketing and lifecycle**

* Own email as a revenue channel.
* Build and run automated flows: welcome, sample request follow up, abandoned basket, abandoned browse, post purchase, review request, re engagement and win back.
* Own the sample request journey. Customers order samples and decide weeks later, so nurturing that decision properly is one of the most valuable things in this business.
* Segment the list properly. Homeowners, trade customers and designers need different messages.
* Own list growth, deliverability, testing, and reporting on revenue per email.

**3\. Affiliate marketing**

* Manage and grow the affiliate programme: recruitment, onboarding, commission structure, creative assets and ongoing partner performance.
* Find and sign new affiliates across home, garden, interiors, renovation and trade niches.
* Report on affiliate contribution to revenue and grow it quarter on quarter.

**4\. Influencer and partnerships**

* Identify, approach and build relationships with influencers, creators, garden designers, landscapers, builders and home renovation accounts in the UK.
* Run partnerships end to end: outreach, negotiation, brief, product, content delivery, publication and measurement.
* Build a repeatable partnerships pipeline rather than one off collaborations.
* Develop brand partnerships and collaborations that put the brand in front of the right audiences.

**5\. Brand and visual assets**

* Be the guardian of how the brand looks and sounds across every channel.
* Own the full visual asset library: product imagery, lifestyle and installation photography, graphics, templates and video produced in house, with proper naming, versioning and organisation.
* Coordinate and direct product and lifestyle shoots. Source, collect and curate real customer installation photography, which is the most valuable content we have.
* Maintain brand consistency across website, marketplaces, social, email and all partner and affiliate material.

**6\. Website and marketplace content**

* Own product listing content on the website: imagery, copy, specifications, categorisation and merchandising.
* Optimise listings for clarity and conversion so every product page gives a customer enough to buy confidently.
* Build campaign and seasonal landing pages and collections.
* Own imagery, A\+ and enhanced brand content and listing copy across marketplaces including Amazon, B\&Q and Wayfair, keeping the brand consistent everywhere it appears. Commercial ownership of marketplaces sits with a separate Marketplaces Lead. You own how the brand looks and reads there.

**7\. Reviews and reputation**

* Own review generation across Trustpilot and Google, including post purchase review flows.
* Monitor and respond to reviews and social mentions.
* Turn customer feedback and finished projects into content.

**8\. Reporting and growth**

* Report monthly on what each channel contributed: revenue from email, affiliate revenue, partnership reach and return, social growth and traffic, and listing performance.
* Track competitors and the category, and bring ideas.

**9\. Wider contribution**

Take on new areas, projects and channels as the business expands. We look for people who want more scope over time and grow into it.

**Who you will work with**

* **Head of Growth Marketing \& Strategy**, your direct line manager, based in the UK. You will work with him daily and have direct access to senior leadership.
* **Our AI motion graphics specialist** in the Hyderabad office. He produces all of our video and motion content and is genuinely excellent at it. You will brief and direct him on what each channel and campaign needs, while you own photography, imagery, design and product presentation. Together you are expected to produce work at a volume and quality that would normally need a whole studio.

jobs.title: Creative Content Strategist
jobs.description:
Job opportunity \- Creative Content Strategist

Location: Hyderabad

Experience: 2–5 years

Function: Branding \& Content

About the role

We’re looking for a Creative Content Strategist who can turn brand requirements, consumer insights and business objectives into strong, distinctive content. You should naturally think in ideas. Given a brief, you should be able to define the idea, why it will work, the right format, how it should look and sound, and what the team needs to do to bring it to life. You don’t need to be a traditional copywriter, designer or editor. You do need a strong understanding of content, storytelling, visual communication and what makes people stop, watch, read and remember.

What you’ll do

● Turn briefs into ideas: Develop concepts, hooks and narratives across brand building, education, entertainment, emotion and product communication. Find interesting ways to make complex or technical subjects engaging.

● Take ideas from concept to execution: Decide the right format — Reel, film, carousel, static, animation, etc. — and define the visual treatment, story, shoot requirements, copy and editing direction.

● Brief and direct creative teams: Create clear briefs and work closely with designers, editors, cinematographers and other creative partners to take an idea from concept to finished output.

● Write and shape the story: Develop or guide headlines, hooks, scripts, VO, supers, captions and CTAs. Know when a story needs more explanation and when fewer words will make it stronger.

● Build and improve content: Identify opportunities for recurring content formats and series. Review creative work, give specific feedback, push beyond the first obvious idea and ensure the final execution delivers on the original thought.

● Protect and strengthen the brand: Translate brand strategy and personality into everyday content while balancing creativity with the need to be honest, credible and easy to understand. Challenge briefs when there’s an opportunity to make the work significantly better.

What we’re looking for

● 4–5 years of experience in content, creative, advertising, brand or digital marketing.

● Someone who thinks in ideas, not just posts.

● Strong understanding of social\-first content, storytelling and visual communication.

● Comfortable moving between strategy, concept and execution.

● Good visual sense, with the ability to articulate what something should look, sound and feel like.

● Understands video, editing and design well enough to direct these disciplines, even if you don’t personally execute them.

● Can write clear, sharp copy and scripts.

● Curious about consumers and understands why people engage with content.

● Can simplify complex subjects into interesting stories.

● Comfortable giving creative feedback and managing multiple projects without compromising the quality of the thinking. You don’t need to be a traditional copywriter, graphic designer, video editor or social media manager. You should understand these disciplines well enough to bring them together into strong creative work.

What good looks like Take a message like:

You should be able to turn it into:

A strong idea → a compelling hook → the right format → a visual/story treatment → a script/copy → a clear execution brief → a great final piece of content.

They come back with 3 genuinely good ideas, each with a clear thought behind it, and know exactly how to make them work.

Portfolio A portfolio is mandatory. We’d particularly like to see:

Pay: ₹700,000\.00 \- ₹900,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Product Manager II
jobs.description:
**Overview**  

Microsoft 365 is a cornerstone of Microsoft's cloud strategy and of our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. The Admin Agentic Experiences team owns a strategic, board\-visible bet: making the administrator experience agentic, so that IT professionals can reason, plan, and act across Copilot, Agents, and Microsoft 365 with the trust, safety, and auditability enterprises require.


We are looking for a customer\-obsessed, analytical Product Manager to own a major slice of the Admin Agentic Experiences charter end to end, from strategy through shipped experience. The product is at an inflection point: we are moving from an experience that primarily informs to one that reasons, plans, and acts across Microsoft 365 workloads, at the trust, safety, and auditability bar enterprises require.


 Administrators are the decisive gatekeepers of Copilot and Agents adoption. They decide when a capability is safe, compliant, and ready to roll out. Your work will close the reasoning and actionability gaps these admins are explicitly asking for, and will span scenarios that reach across Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, Copilot, Commerce, Message Center, Service Health, and more. The scope carries real ambiguity and demands influence well beyond your own team, so you should be comfortable setting direction where none exists yet and bringing partner teams along with you.

 **Responsibilities*** Own the strategy\-to\-execution plan for high\-frequency, high\-impact admin scenarios, and define what success looks like in measurable terms.
* Engage directly with IT administrators and partners to understand their jobs to be done, and translate that understanding into agentic experiences that reason, plan, and act.
* Define AI\-powered experiences that meet the enterprise bar for trust, safety, grounding, and auditability, working closely with responsible AI and compliance partners.
* Drive cross\-domain orchestration with the Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, Copilot, Commerce, and Message Center and Service Health teams to expand persona and scenario coverage.
* Partner with data science and analytics teams to build the telemetry, evaluation, and quality loops that show whether the agent is genuinely helping admins.
* Refine and scope front\-end requirements from deep empathy for the admin journey, delivering experiences that feel simple even when the underlying orchestration is not.
* Build strong working relationships with engineering teams across geographies, and hold a clear bar for on\-time, high\-quality delivery.
* Drive the operational processes for capturing, prioritizing, and removing adoption blockers, and connect the work to downstream outcomes such as Copilot license assignment, sustained usage, and support incident deflection.
* Support our goals for diversity and inclusion through everyday actions and communications.
 **Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in technical or business discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* 4 to 7 years of product management experience, including running complex matrixed programs with detailed product definition and interpersonal negotiation.
* Hands\-on experience with AI and current developments in the field, including practical exposure to building or shipping AI\-powered experiences.
* Demonstrated ability to use data to influence and drive decisions.

 Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Microsoft 365 administration, enterprise IT management, or adjacent control\-plane products, and an understanding of what enterprise administrators are accountable for.
* Knowledge of agentic or conversational AI systems, including orchestration, grounding, evaluation, and the trust and safety considerations that come with taking action on a customer's behalf.
* Proven track record of going technically deep and delivering cloud\-scale technologies.
* Skill in navigating complex organizational structures with loose affiliations and competing priorities, and in negotiating common ground to drive prioritization of key deliverables.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to listen, distill information into insights, and tailor the message to different audiences from engineers to executives.
* Experience with prototyping or wireframing tools to communicate ideas quickly to stakeholders.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
 We're hiring a Technical Product Manager who can hold the platform's integrations and data flows in their head, turn that into a clear product vision, and take it through to a shipped, adopted result. You'll spend real time in the technical weeds, reading integration docs, reasoning about data models, and prototyping ideas yourself before handing them to engineering. You own the roadmap and you own delivery.
   

  

**Technical Skills We're Looking For**
 This is a product role, not an engineering role. You won't be writing production code day to day, but you need to be comfortable enough with code and systems to prototype, pull data, or debug something yourself when it matters.
   

  

**Our stack :** 
 Node.js, TypeScript, Express, and Drizzle on the backend. React, TypeScript, Zustand, and TanStack on the frontend. Postgres for the database, Redis for caching, and JWT for authentication. Event streaming runs across services, with Azure Blob Storage for files. Our AI layer runs on Python, Streamlit, ChromaDB, and RAG.
   

  

* Can read API docs and data models without engineering translating.
* Comfortable reading and reasoning about a TypeScript codebase, front end and back end.
* SQL literacy, comfortable querying Postgres directly to pull and interpret data.
* Understands authentication (JWT), event\-driven architecture, and third\-party integrations.
* Can write or edit a simple TypeScript or Python script for a prototype or data pull.
* Familiarity with RAG pipelines and vector databases (like ChromaDB) is a strong plus.
* Hands\-on experience with Node.js, React, TypeScript, or Python is a strong plus.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the product vision and roadmap for an AI\-first, agentic operator experience.
* Balance near\-term commitments against longer\-term platform and AI investment.
* Get deep enough into integrations and data flows to make calls without an engineer translating for you.
* Define where AI recommendations or automation remove manual work, and set the guardrails that make it safe.
* Write specs and acceptance criteria engineering can build against the first time, including analytics requirements.
* Run discovery with operators and consumers, and turn findings into prioritized problems.
* Track your initiatives through delivery, flag risk early, and present results to leadership clearly.


**What You Bring**
* 6\-8 years in product management, including 2\+ years owning something with real technical complexity.
* A track record of shipping outcomes you can point to specific metrics for, not just shipping features.
* Experience defining requirements for AI/automation features, including guardrails and failure modes.
* Strong prototyping instincts: comfortable with design tools, no\-code platforms, or AI\-assisted prototyping.
* Sharp communication that flexes between an engineering deep\-dive and a concise executive update.
* Experience designing for time\-constrained, non\-technical, or mobile\-first users.
* A bias toward ownership: you finish what you start and flag problems before they compound.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience in hospitality, travel, marketplace, or commerce platforms.
* Prior experience with loyalty, payments, or booking/reservation systems.
* Experience defining requirements for conversational or voice\-based AI interfaces.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Product Owner (PO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is accountable for the end‑to‑end ownership, delivery, and adoption of enterprise data products. This role serves as the single point of accountability for product vision, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, and experience quality across assigned data domains.
   

  

 The Product Owner partners closely with
 **Business stakeholders, Data Engineering, BI/Reporting, Data Science, Governance, and Platform teams** 
 to ensure data products are reliable, intuitive, scalable, and aligned with Kroll’s strategic priorities. The role emphasizes
 **clarity of ownership, predictable delivery, and measurable business impact** 
 in a complex, enterprise data environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership \& Accountability**
* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for enterprise data, analytics, or AI product areas.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for product outcomes, delivery health, and user experience.
* Define and communicate product goals, success metrics, and value drivers to stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Ensure products operate with clear ownership, release discipline, and lifecycle management, behaving like true products—not one‑off projects.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Business Alignment**
* Act as the primary interface between the CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Partner with stakeholders to prioritize demand, manage tradeoffs, and align delivery to business timelines.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements without compromising data integrity or architectural standards.
* Establish and maintain trusted relationships that enable fast decision‑making and alignment.


**Backlog, Roadmap \& Delivery Management**
* Own and maintain a prioritized, well‑defined backlog with clear acceptance criteria and readiness standards.
* Work with Program Managers, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to plan releases and manage dependencies.
* Balance short‑term delivery needs with long‑term product health, scalability, and maintainability.
* Surface risks, constraints, or scope trade‑offs early to enable leadership decisions.


**Governance, Quality \& Standards**
* Partner with Data Governance, Data Stewards, and Platform Owners to ensure:
+ Consistent KPI definitions and metric logic
+ Data quality, lineage, and trust standards
+ Alignment with enterprise data architecture and security policies

* Ensure products meet operational readiness standards prior to release and are supported post‑launch.


**Adoption, Value \& Continuous Improvement**
* Drive product adoption by ensuring solutions is intuitive, reliable, and aligned to real user workflows.
* Define and track usage, adoption, and value realization metrics.
* Collect feedback and iterate to continuously improve product experience and impact.
* Support leadership by providing a clear narrative on what is delivered, what value it creates, and what comes next.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Analytics, or Data‑centric roles.
* Proven ability to own roadmaps, backlogs, and stakeholder relationships in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of data, reporting, analytics, or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks, data warehouses).
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models with engineering and analytics teams.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate between business objectives and technical execution.


**Preferred**
* Experience in a Chief Data Office, Analytics, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with data governance, semantic models, KPI standardization, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience supporting finance, operations, or enterprise‑wide reporting domains.
* Prior experience working in a vendor‑heavy environment and helping transition to more internal ownership.


**Leadership Behaviors \& Expectations**
* Operates with clear ownership and accountability.
* Brings structure, clarity, and discipline to ambiguous problem spaces.
* Makes trade‑offs explicitly and escalates decisions appropriately.
* Focuses on outcomes and value, not just delivery.
* Trusted partner to both business leaders and technical teams.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Product Owner is a
 **critical enabler of CDO’s product‑led operating model** 
 , ensuring that data and analytics investments deliver consistent, trusted, and measurable value to the firm—while reducing dependency on informal workarounds, fragmented ownership, and vendor‑driven execution.

jobs.title: AI-Native Systems Builder
jobs.job_function: General Business, Management, and Business Development
jobs.description:
We're looking for builders.
   

  

 Not product managers. Not software engineers. Not AI researchers. People who happen to do all three when the problem demands it — because they care more about solving the problem than about which lane it falls in.
   

  

****What this role is****
 Darwinbox is an enterprise HCM platform used by hundreds of large organizations across multiple countries. We're in the middle of a fundamental shift — rearchitecting the product and the company to be AI\-native. Not adding AI features to an existing system. Rebuilding how the system thinks, operates, and delivers value.
   

  

 This role exists because the most important work in that transformation doesn't fit traditional job boundaries. It sits at the intersection of product thinking, systems engineering, enterprise domain knowledge, and AI — and it requires people who can hold all of that in their head while shipping something that actually works.
   

  

 You will take ambiguous, high\-stakes enterprise problems and turn them into working systems. Some will be customer\-facing product capabilities. Some will be internal operational systems. All of them will require you to think deeply about the realities of enterprise software — permissions, auditability, multi\-tenancy, scale, configurability, edge cases — because that's where most "AI\-powered" systems quietly break.
   

  

****What the work looks like****
 You won't get a detailed spec. You'll get a problem.
   

  

 It might sound like: "Our customers can't tell whether their employees are actually using the platform — and neither can we." Or: "Implementation consultants spend 40% of their time on work that should be systematized." Or: "This workflow was designed for humans filling forms — redesign it for a world where AI handles 80% of the steps."
   

  

 Your job is to go from that problem statement to a production system. You'll need to understand the business context, design the solution, build it (using AI\-native development workflows extensively), validate it against real enterprise complexity, and iterate until it works — not in a demo, but at scale, with real customers, in production.
   

  

****Who thrives here****
 People who build things outside of work — not because someone asked, but because they saw a problem and couldn't leave it unsolved.
   

  

 People who use AI tools daily and have strong opinions about where they're transformative and where they're dangerous.
   

  

 People who think in systems — who instinctively ask "what breaks downstream?" and "what happens at 100x scale?" and "what's the edge case no one mentioned?"
   

  

 People who've shipped things. Not prototyped. Shipped. In environments where the user didn't forgive rough edges.
   

  

 You might come from engineering, product, consulting, design, operations, or a path that doesn't have a clean label. We genuinely don't care about the label. We care about how you think, how you simplify, and what you've built.
   

  

****What we explicitly don't optimize for****
* Resume pedigree as a proxy for capability
* Interview performance on problems you'd never encounter here
* AI enthusiasm without AI execution
* Coordination\-heavy profiles that produce slides instead of systems
* Prototype thinking without production realism


****Why this role exists****
 Most companies hire PMs to write specs, engineers to execute them, and analysts to measure the outcome. Three roles, three handoffs, three points of context loss.
   

  

 We're building a company where one person can hold the full arc — problem to system to outcome — because we believe that's how the best enterprise software gets built in the AI era.
   

  

 If that sounds like how you already think, we should talk.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad

**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
 At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe**
 Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.
   

  

 In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.
   

  

 Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.
   

  

 Crowe’s Microsoft Consulting Practice is hiring an
 **Agentic Business Process Analyst** 
 to help clients rethink how work gets done in the AI era. This is not a traditional business analyst role focused only on documenting requirements, writing user stories, or mapping current\-state processes. This role is for someone who can diagnose business problems, understand root causes, redesign processes, and identify where AI agents, automation, data, and human judgment should come together.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is deeply functional, process\-oriented, and comfortable enough with technology to work side by side with engineers, architects, and client IT teams. This person should be able to bridge business and technology, helping clients move from legacy workflows to intelligent, agent\-enabled processes.
   

  

 This role also has an internal transformation mandate. The person will help upskill Crowe Consulting teams that may be used to traditional ERP, CRM, or business application delivery. They will help consultants develop a more modern mindset: start with problems, then processes, then technology.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Lead discovery sessions with clients to understand business goals, pain points, process breakdowns, data issues, user needs, controls, and operating constraints.
* Map end\-to\-end business processes, including inputs, outputs, roles, systems, decisions, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and performance measures.
* Diagnose root causes across people, process, data, and technology before recommending solutions.
* Identify opportunities for AI assistance, agentic augmentation, workflow orchestration, automation, knowledge retrieval, decision support, and process improvement.
* Partner with technical architects and engineers to translate process opportunities into solution designs, prototypes, functional specifications, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
* Define business value measures for agentic solutions, such as time saved, cycle time reduction, first\-time\-right rate, SLA performance, adoption, override rate, CSAT, cost per transaction, revenue lift, and compliance improvement.
* Help clients decide where humans should stay in control, where AI should assist, and where agents can safely orchestrate or automate work.
* Support workshops, demos, process redesign sessions, executive presentations, and change management conversations.
* Create reusable playbooks, templates, process models, and training materials to help Crowe teams adopt an agentic business analysis approach.
* Coach Crowe consultants on how to move beyond legacy requirements gathering into diagnostic, value\-led, AI\-enabled transformation work.


**What Success Looks Like**
* You can walk into a messy client process and make sense of it quickly.
* You can separate symptoms from root causes.
* You know when the right answer is process redesign, data cleanup, integration, training, governance, automation, or AI.
* You can help clients and internal teams understand what agents should do, what humans should do, and how to measure whether the new process is better.
* You make technical teams sharper by giving them better process context, and you make business teams more confident by helping them understand what technology can realistically do.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 6\+ years as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, or Process Consultant.
* Strong business process mapping and redesign experience.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform implementations.
* Ability to facilitate client workshops and engage executive stakeholders.
* Exposure to AI, automation, or agentic transformation initiatives.
* Experience partnering with technical teams to deliver business solutions.
* Consulting or professional services background.
* Leadership or mentoring experience.

* Experience with Dynamics 365…

* Communicates program status, resilience risks, and recovery\-readiness insights to Security leadership, ELT stakeholders, and the CISO, ensuring transparency and accountability across the organization.


**Drives Efficiency**
* Standardizes documentation templates, dependency inventories, RTO/RPO tiering models, and reporting formats to improve consistency, audit readiness, and stakeholder clarity.
* Implements structured corrective\-action tracking with defined owners, evidence requirements, and measurable closure timelines to reduce resiliency gaps systematically.
* Streamlines enterprise Testing, Exercises, and Continuous Improvement workflows to ensure learnings from incidents and simulations translate into actionable improvements.
* Brings order to complex cross\-functional recovery planning by aligning business\-unit expectations, technical recovery capabilities, and regulatory guidance into practical, sustainable processes.


**Innovative**
* Applies structured analysis and scenario modeling to identify disruption patterns, hidden dependencies, and resilience blind spots that may not be visible through standard documentation reviews.
* Leverages AI and automation tools to enhance plan governance, corrective\-action tracking, dependency mapping, and reporting workflows—improving efficiency, scalability, and real\-time visibility into recovery readiness metrics.

**About GoKwik**
 GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, enabling checkout optimisation, RTO reduction, payments, retention, and post\-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik powers 15,000\+ merchants globally, processes \~$2 billion in GMV, and continues to strengthen its AI\-powered infrastructure across India, the UK, Europe, and the US.
   

  

 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 Customer engagement is rapidly evolving from static communication to intelligent, AI\-powered conversations. KwikEngage sits at the centre of this transformation, helping brands manage customer interactions, automate support, drive retention, and deliver personalised experiences across channels.
   

  

 As the Senior Product Manager for KwikEngage, you will own the product strategy and execution for conversational commerce and AI\-led customer engagement.  Product Strategy \& Roadmap

* Build and scale customer engagement experiences across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Email, RCS, and Web
* Drive adoption of conversational commerce workflows across merchant use cases
* Build products that improve customer engagement, conversion, retention, and support efficiency
* Identify opportunities to create differentiated experiences across the messaging ecosystem


 AI \& Conversational Product Experiences
   

  

* Own AI\-powered product capabilities across chatbots, customer support, CRM, and lifecycle engagement
* Build and iterate on LLM\-powered workflows, conversational experiences, and intelligent automation
* Define how AI and human agents work together across customer interactions
* Improve automation and resolution rates while maintaining response quality and customer experience
* Explore emerging AI capabilities and translate them into scalable product experiences


 Inbox, Support \& Agent Experience
   

  

* Own inbox, live chat, ticketing, routing, escalation, and agent workflows
* Build tools that improve agent productivity, response times, and resolution rates
* Design seamless handoffs between AI bots and human agents
* Use product and operational data to continuously improve support workflows


 Platform \& Integrations
   

  

* Own integrations across Meta platforms and other messaging and communication channels
* Partner closely with Engineering to build scalable, reliable, and extensible platform capabilities

* Build platform capabilities that enable rapid development of new engagement use cases


 Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Execution
   

  

* Work closely with Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing to take products from concept to scale

* Communicate product decisions, trade\-offs, priorities, and progress clearly across stakeholders
* Develop a deep understanding of merchants, end customers, and the broader conversational commerce ecosystem


 Who You Are
   

  

* 4–7 years of Product Management experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, D2C technology, CRM, customer engagement, or conversational products
* Strong product sense with experience owning customer\-facing products end\-to\-end
* Hands\-on experience building or shipping AI/LLM\-powered products is mandatory
* Strong understanding of LLMs, conversational AI, chatbot platforms, or AI\-driven workflows
* Experience taking AI/ML capabilities from concept to production and measuring their impact
* Prior exposure to conversational commerce, customer support, CRM, or engagement platforms is preferred
* Familiarity with WhatsApp Business APIs, Meta ecosystem, or messaging platforms is a strong plus
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a data\-driven approach to product decisions
* Comfortable working closely with engineering teams and understanding technical trade\-offs
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* High ownership mindset with the ability to operate independently in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment

 At GoKwik, you'll build products that power millions of customer interactions every month. You'll work at the intersection of AI, commerce, and customer engagement, shaping how thousands of brands interact with their customers.

 Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents.  You'll own the integration and automation layer connecting Docusign's CRM, CPQ, and billing systems—and play a leading role in bringing AI capabilities into the commerce platform. This means defining how AI services are exposed, integrated, and operationalized across commerce applications. You'll also define integration patterns, establish observability standards, and drive complex cross\-functional initiatives. * Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and tooling such as Jira and Confluence
* Related technical degree (Computer Science, Engineering) or equivalent practical experience


**Preferred**
* Masters in Business, computer applications or other advanced degrees
* Experience building assistants, agents, copilots, or AI products that use tools to complete tasks
* Certification in Lean Six Sigma, Agile and Product Management
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clarity and alignment across senior cross\-functional stakeholders


 Life at Docusign
   

  

**Working here**
 Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

jobs.description:
Principal Product Manager \- Agentic Investigation \& Reliability Experiences
   

  

 Sumo Logic is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead how engineers and operators investigate incidents, understand reliability risk, and act on their operational and security telemetry.
   

  

 The observability category was built around collecting telemetry and giving people tools to navigate it: dashboards, queries, monitors, traces, and alerts. Customer expectations are now shifting. Teams don't just want more dashboards; they want help getting from a signal to a resolution, understanding what's broken, why, what's impacted, and what to do next. As AI agents move into production operations, this role owns how Sumo Logic brings intelligent, agent\-assisted investigation and reliability workflows to customers, grounded in evidence, context, and enterprise governance.
   

  

 This is a senior, high\-ownership role. It requires genuine observability domain background. You should have lived in this space and understand how monitoring, troubleshooting, and reliability actually work, combined with the ambition to define a new category of experience on top of it.
   

  

 What You Will Own
   

  

**The current data experiences.** 
 Log Search, Live Tail, query and query optimization, Metrics Search, Tracing, Dashboards, and the data\-experience UI. This is a live, revenue\-generating product with real customers, and keeping it strong is part of the job. You own its health, roadmap, and competitiveness today while steering it toward an AI\-native future, focusing new investment where it strengthens investigation, speed, and value for both new and power users.
   

  

**The reliability and alerting surface.** 
 Monitors, Alerts, SLOs, Scheduled Searches, and the reliability workflows around them. You will own alerting accuracy, noise reduction, and operational health signals both as capabilities customers depend on today and as the foundation for more automated, agent\-assisted detection and investigation.
   

  

**The agentic investigation experience.** 
 You will define how a user moves from a search, a monitor, a dashboard, or an alert to likely cause faster, with supporting evidence. This means productizing investigation workflows that reason across logs, metrics, traces, monitors, dashboards, and related context, and evolving them from reactive troubleshooting toward more proactive detection over time.
   

  

 What You Will Be Doing
   

  

* Set the multi\-quarter vision for Sumo Logic's investigation and reliability experiences, and turn it into a roadmap engineering can execute against.
* Own the roadmap, health, and competitiveness of the current data and reliability product surfaces.
* Define how search, metrics, tracing, dashboards, monitors, alerts, and SLOs evolve from human\-navigated tools into more intuitive, AI\-assisted experiences.
* Productize investigation workflows that reason across telemetry and related operational context, and surface findings customers can act on.
* Own alerting accuracy, noise reduction, and operational health signals.
* Shape how skills, tools, and agents are built on top of the data surfaces, and ensure they respect enterprise controls such as RBAC, audit, cost limits, and approvals.
* Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, performance, and reliability at enterprise scale.
* Translate strategy into clear PRDs, proposals, user stories, acceptance criteria, and phased rollout plans.
* Use telemetry to understand how customers search, investigate, and configure alerts, and where they hit friction, latency, false positives, or cost.
* Create leadership\-facing proposals that frame tradeoffs across customer demand, governance, performance, cost, and long\-term architecture.


 What You Bring
   

  

* 8\+ years of product management experience with real observability or monitoring domain background. You have owned products in observability, monitoring, incident response, APM, or a closely adjacent operational\-telemetry space. This is a hard requirement.
* Deep, first\-hand understanding of the observability surface area including logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, monitors, alerts, and SLOs, and of how engineers and operators actually investigate incidents and decide what to trust.
* Proven ability to run a live, at\-scale product, owning the roadmap, health, and competitiveness of shipping surfaces while driving a larger transformation.
* A track record of owning broad, technically deep surfaces and setting direction that other teams build on.
* Familiarity with how AI and agents are changing data interaction, including natural\-language investigation, tools, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop action, or the ability to ramp quickly.
* Strong technical instincts around query engines, time\-series and trace data, and alerting systems, plus the judgment to know where an AI\-assisted experience should replace a manual flow and where depth must stay.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using telemetry, dashboards, SQL, and usage data to understand adoption, friction, reliability, and cost.
* Excellent communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write clear proposals, decision docs, PRDs, and acceptance criteria.
* High ownership and drive to make progress across a large, ambiguous, fast\-moving surface.


 Must\-Have Qualities
   

  

* Runs today, builds tomorrow. Keeps a live product healthy and competitive while reinventing it, and knows what to sustain and what to rebuild.
* Deep observability judgment. Understands search, metrics, tracing, and alerting well enough to make hard architecture and tradeoff calls with engineering.
* Operator empathy. Knows what makes an alert trustworthy, an investigation fast, and a recommendation credible enough to act on.
* Governance\-minded. Treats RBAC, audit, cost, and approvals as part of the product.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**
 Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody.  Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients. 
   

  

 BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma\-to\-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world\-class support on this first\-of\-its\-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock. 
   

  

 We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!
 



 Senior Product Managers at Blink are innovators, craftspeople and business thinkers. Your job as a Sr Product Manager is to take ownership over our hardest problems, envision and refine strategic solutions, and drive execution like an entrepreneur. You will collaborate closely with a talented, cross\-functional team of engineers, designers, product managers, data scientists, marketers, and operators. Through these partnerships, you’ll grow our business, build our core platform, and \- above all \- make sure that our customers have access to the least expensive and highest satisfaction pharmacy experience on earth.  
 



 At Blink, we determine the specific focus of product roles through the interview process. Key potential areas of ownership include: our telemedicine platform; our home delivery experience; our growth team; our core cloud pharmacy platform; new product line development and strategic platforms. We’ll work with you to find the right fit. All PM roles include driving product strategy, roadmapping, rapid testing and research, release planning, experimentation and analysis. PMs are expected to become true experts in pharmacy systems \- so that we can transform them. And they are expected to become experts in our customers \- so that we can provide a truly unparalleled experience to them.
 



 While this role is based in India, you will work on global products that require partnership with teams across regions. We are also aggressively growing our teams in India and this role will be one of our founding product based roles here.
 



**About You** 



* Experienced \- you have 6\+ years as a product manager, either with strong consumer or deep platform experience.
* Proven Builder \- you have delivered multiple successful and innovative products from ‘0 to 1 to n’. You can point directly to growth/engagement/success metrics on these products.
* Consumer\-Obsessed \- you always think first about the consumer, hunt for empathy, and do everything possible to give the customer the best possible experience.
* Analytical \- you naturally break hard problems into their pieces, are deeply familiar with best\-in\-class experimentation practices, use key results to drive strategies, and basically just measure everything.
* Driven and Biased\-to\-Action \- you can manage through complexity, lead with influence, make hard decisions, and persevere when things are challenging. You are hungry to win and you have the grit to make it happen.
* Collaborative and Communicative \- you love being part of a diverse team, building consensus, and establishing credibility. You are a Class\-A communicator: curious, thoughtful, clear, and (mostly) correct.
* Technical \- an engineering background/skills are highly preferred for Product roles at Blink. You will work closely with engineering teams and will need to appreciate technical nuances of the solutions being built.
* BE/B Tech degree from top institution; MBA or Computer Science degree preferred but not mandatory.



**Why Join Us:**
 It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.  Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross\-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

 Applicants who provide their phone number and consent to receive text messages may receive SMS or MMS updates from Blink Health regarding their application.

 We are looking for a proactive and user\-focused Product Planner to translate business and user requirements into well\-defined product features, user experiences, operational policies, and workflows. * Define requirements for new product features and services based on user and business needs.
* Design user journeys, UX flows, wireframes, screens, and product workflows.

* Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong problem\-solving ability with a user\-centric mindset.
* Ability to work effectively with developers, designers, and other stakeholders.

This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. I

This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. Okta's Identity Governance (OIG) organization is looking for a **Senior Engineer** to join our Identity Administration team — a team that is directly responsible for one of the most critical and visible workflows in enterprise identity: how employees request, approve, and gain access to the resources they need.

  


**Opportunity**



As a Senior Engineer on the OIG Identity Administration team, you will be involved in development, design, and maintenance of our product to serve enterprise customers at scale. You will involve the development and evolution of our product features — spanning the across different identity entities and personas — and work collaboratively across engineering, product, and design to deliver features that are secure, scalable, and delightful to use.



This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, leads with craft, and is energized by the challenge of building enterprise\-grade software that millions of users depend on.



This is a rare opportunity to join a team where your technical decisions will directly shape how thousands of enterprises manage access governance at scale, where the technical challenges are genuinely hard, and where the work you ship will be seen and felt by real users every day.

  


**Job Duties And Responsibilities**

  


* Take end\-to\-end ownership of feature areas — from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-launch monitoring
* Design, build, and ship high\-quality, production\-ready features across the OIG system, with a focus on correctness, reliability, and performance
* Quickly deliver high\-quality bug fixes and handle customer\-reported issues
* Write clean, well\-tested, maintainable code and hold yourself and teammates to a high bar for engineering quality
* Partner with our Product Development, QA, and Site Reliability Engineering teams for scoping the development and deployment work

  


**Required knowledge, skills, and abilities:**


* 5\+ years of experience with Java (Spring/Dropwizard) and/or Golang, with a deep understanding of multi\-threading and asynchronous processing.
* Experience building high\-performance RESTful APIs and/or gRPC services.
* Solid experience with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and caching layers (Redis) at scale.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS (Fargate, EC2, Lambda) and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform). You should be comfortable managing your own cloud resources.
* Strong proficiency with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and CI/CD automation tools (Jenkins, ArgoCD, or GitHub Actions).

**Nice to haves:**


* Understanding of OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, and JWT tokens, specifically for service\-to\-service communication.
* Experience with Splunk, SignalFX, or Datadog for monitoring and troubleshooting production issues.
* Familiarity with Kafka or SQS for handling cross\-org asynchronous events.
* Basic familiarity with React/JavaScript to help integrate backend services.
* Understanding of how to build and deploy services across isolated infrastructure units


**Education and Training:**


* B.S. Computer Science or related field

jobs.title: Oracle APEX & Oracle Fusion Cloud Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
**About The Company**

We are calling candidates on behalf of a Software Solutions company headquartered in East Brunswick, NJ. Incorporated in 2003, It provides comprehensive range of solutions in the area of GRC, Technology, Procurement, Healthcare Provider and Oracle to customers across the globe. Combining our unparalleled experience of over a decade in the software industry and global reach, we have grown with extensive capabilities across industry verticals.

**Job Title: Oracle APEX \& Oracle Fusion Cloud Solutions Architect**

**Location: Bangalore (Work from Office / Hybrid as applicable)**

**Experience: 10\+ Years**

**Engagement Type: Long\-term / Multi\-year (Contract / Full\-time)**

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Oracle APEX \& Oracle Fusion Cloud Solutions Architect to lead the architecture, design, development, integration, and delivery of a custom Agent Billing platform as part of Project Fusion. The solution will support the calculation, review, approval, reconciliation, and invoicing of monthly agent charges that are not supported natively within Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

The successful candidate will architect and build a scalable Oracle PaaS\-based application using Oracle APEX, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Oracle Fusion REST APIs, and Oracle Database technologies. The platform will operate as a billing orchestration and calculation engine tightly integrated with Oracle Fusion Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Projects, Customer, Supplier, and AP/AR Netting processes.

The role requires strong hands\-on Oracle architecture and development expertise, with the ability to translate complex business billing requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable solutions and provide technical leadership from requirements through production implementation.

**Key Responsibilities**

Solution Architecture \& Business Analysis

* Work with business stakeholders, finance teams, product owners, and Oracle functional teams to understand agent billing processes, business rules, exceptions, approvals, reconciliation requirements, and invoicing scenarios.
* Translate business requirements into end\-to\-end solution architecture, application components, data models, integration flows, security controls, and implementation roadmaps.
* Design the Agent Billing platform as an extension to Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP capabilities without unnecessarily duplicating native Fusion functionality.
* Define functional and technical boundaries between Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle APEX, Oracle Database, OIC, and supporting PaaS services.
* Design scalable architecture capable of supporting monthly billing cycles, high transaction volumes, auditability, traceability, and future business expansion.

**Oracle APEX \& Application Development**

* Design and develop enterprise\-grade applications using Oracle APEX, including user interfaces, interactive reports, dashboards, forms, workflows, validations, and role\-based functionality.
* Build robust calculation and billing orchestration logic for monthly agent charges, including configurable business rules, adjustments, exceptions, approvals, and reconciliation.
* Design reusable APEX components and application patterns following Oracle development and enterprise architecture standards.
* Implement application\-level audit trails, status tracking, exception management, and operational reporting.
* Optimize APEX applications for performance, usability, maintainability, and secure enterprise deployment.

**Oracle Fusion Cloud Integration \& OIC**

* Architect and implement integrations between Oracle APEX and Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, and other appropriate Oracle integration mechanisms.
* Integrate with Oracle Fusion Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Projects, Customer, Supplier, and AP/AR Netting processes.
* Design reliable integration patterns for data synchronization, transaction creation/update, status retrieval, error handling, retries, reconciliation, and monitoring.
* Develop and maintain OIC integrations, mappings, transformations, orchestration flows, and exception\-handling mechanisms.
* Ensure integration designs are loosely coupled, secure, scalable, observable, and aligned with Oracle Fusion Cloud integration standards.

**Billing, Reconciliation \& Financial Processing**

* Architect the end\-to\-end lifecycle for agent charge calculation, review, approval, reconciliation, and invoicing.
* Design calculation engines and configurable rules to accommodate complex monthly agent billing scenarios not natively supported by Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.
* Design reconciliation processes between the custom billing platform and Oracle Fusion financial transactions.
* Support integration with AR invoicing, AP processing, customer and supplier master data, project\-related transactions, and AP/AR Netting.
* Ensure financial data integrity, transaction traceability, controls, and auditability across the billing lifecycle.

**Database \& Data Architecture**

* Design Oracle Database schemas, data models, tables, views, stored procedures, packages, functions, sequences, indexes, and data access patterns supporting the platform.
* Develop efficient SQL and PL/SQL for billing calculations, data processing, validation, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Define data retention, audit, archival, performance, and data\-quality strategies.
* Optimize database performance and ensure appropriate transaction management and concurrency controls.

**Security, Performance \& Production Readiness**

* Design application and integration security including authentication, authorization, role\-based access, API security, secrets management, and least\-privilege principles.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of duties and access controls for billing preparation, review, approval, reconciliation, and financial processing.
* Define performance, scalability, availability, logging, monitoring, and operatio…

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Mem0**
==============


We're building the memory layer for AI agents: long\-term memory that lets AI remember conversations, learn from interactions, and build real context over time, the difference between a chatbot and something that actually knows you. We're already powering millions of AI interactions for enterprise customers and a fast\-growing open\-source community (160k\+ developers and counting).


We're backed by top\-tier investors through a $24M Series A \& Seed, early enough that the systems you build now become the foundation everything else is built on.


This role owns the backend behind that platform. You'll design clean REST APIs, model data across relational and graph stores, and operate services in production. When customers hit issues, you'll chase them down to root cause, ship fixes, and harden the system, working closely with frontend and research to deliver fast, reliable features.


You'll design the core systems, decide how they're built, and stay with them through production. Our users are developers integrating us into their own agents, which means the APIs you design are the product as far as they're concerned.


This role reports directly to Deshraj Yadav, our Co\-founder and CTO, and works closely with the engineering team in San Francisco.

**What you'll do**
==================

* **Design \& ship REST APIs:** Define contracts, versioning, auth, rate limits; write migrations and docs.
* **Model data \& schemas:** Relational (Postgres) and graph (e.g. Neo4j); enforce integrity and performance.
* **Debug customer issues end to end:** Trace with logs, metrics and traces, reproduce, fix, and write preventative guardrails.
* **Optimize performance:** Tune slow SQL with EXPLAIN/ANALYZE, indexes, partitioning, pagination, and caching (e.g. Redis).
* **Build services in Python:** Async where it helps (FastAPI, Django/DRF, Flask), background jobs, queues, schedulers.
* **Operate in the cloud:** Containerize with Docker, deploy on Kubernetes (EKS), and use AWS primitives (EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM).
* **Instrument everything:** Custom metrics, structured logging, tracing; set SLOs and alerts (CloudWatch/Prometheus/OpenTelemetry).
* **Collaborate \& ship:** Work with frontend and research to scope APIs and deliver features to production.

**Minimum qualifications**
==========================

* 5\+ years building backend systems and shipping REST APIs to production.
* Strong Python fundamentals; experience with async programming and a major web framework (FastAPI/Django/Flask).
* Solid data modeling and SQL skills; hands\-on with query tuning and performance debugging in Postgres/MySQL.
* Experience with graph databases (e.g. Neo4j or Amazon Neptune) and the data modeling trade\-offs that come with them.
* Comfortable running services on AWS with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Demonstrated root\-cause analysis and ownership from incident to prevention.
* Clear communicator and effective collaborator with frontend, research, and customers.

**Nice to have**
================

* GraphQL/gRPC; event\-driven systems (SNS/SQS/Kafka) and background workers (Celery/RQ).
* Caching, rate limiting, multi\-tenancy, and feature\-flag strategies.
* Security \& privacy best practices (PII handling, secrets management).
* Deep observability experience (OpenTelemetry, SLO\-based alerting).
* Prior work with search/retrieval or memory systems.
* On\-call experience and running blameless postmortems.
* Prior time at an early\-stage startup. Series A, YC, or founding engineer experience tells us a lot.

**Our culture**
===============

* **Velocity with craftsmanship:** We build for the long term, not just shipping features. We move fast but never sacrifice reliability or thoughtful design. Every system needs to be fast, reliable, and elegant.
* **Extreme ownership:** Everyone at Mem0 is a builder\-owner. If you spot a problem or opportunity, you have the agency to fix it. Titles are light; impact is heavy.
* **High bar, high trust:** We hire for talent and potential, then give people room to run. Code is reviewed, ideas are challenged, and wins are celebrated, always with respect and curiosity.
* **Data\-driven, not ego\-driven:** The best solution wins, whether it comes from a founder or an engineer who joined yesterday. We let results and metrics guide our decisions.

jobs.title: Lead Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Lead Product Owner (LPO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is responsible for
 **end‑to‑end ownership, consistency, and execution excellence across multiple data, analytics, and reporting products or domains** 
 . This role ensures alignment between business priorities, product strategy, and delivery execution.
   

  

 The Lead Product Owner acts as the
 **central accountability point across a portfolio of related products** 
 , coaching and guiding Product Owners, establishing standards, and partnering closely with Program Management, Data Engineering, and Governance to deliver predictable, high‑quality outcomes.
   

  

 This role is critical to enabling
 **product‑led execution at scale** 
 within the CDO.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio‑Level Product Ownership**
* Own the overall product vision and execution strategy across a defined product portfolio or domain (e.g., Reporting, Self‑Service Analytics, Finance Analytics, Data Platforms).
* Ensure each product has:
+ A clear purpose and roadmap
+ Defined success metrics
+ Consistent experience and standards

* Act as the final decision authority on prioritization, scope tradeoffs, and acceptance across related products.


**Leadership \& Coaching**
* Lead, mentor, and coach Product Owners to ensure consistent product ownership practices and decision quality.
* Set and enforce standards for backlog quality, roadmap clarity, and stakeholder communication.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex prioritization, dependency, or scope conflicts.
* Raise the overall product ownership maturity across CDO.


**Stakeholder Alignment \& Business Partnership**
* Serve as an interface between CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Translate enterprise priorities into sequenced, realistic roadmaps.
* Manage competing stakeholder demands by making transparent, value‑based trade‑offs.
* Ensure stakeholders have confidence in what will be delivered, when, and why.


**Roadmap, Backlog \& Delivery Governance**
* Maintain a portfolio‑level roadmap, aligned with capacity, dependencies, and strategic priorities.
* Ensure Product Owners maintain well‑defined, ready backlogs that support predictable delivery.
* Partner with Program Managers and Scrum Masters to:
+ Align sprint and release plans
+ Surface risks and constraints early
+ Manage cross‑team dependencies

* Ensure delivery adheres to CDO governance, readiness, and release standards.


**Quality, Governance \& Trust**
* Partner with Data Governance, Architecture, and Platform teams to:
+ Enforce consistent KPI definitions and semantic standards
+ Uphold data quality, lineage, and trust expectations
+ Ensure security and compliance requirements are met

* Ensure products are operationally ready and supported post‑release.


**Value Realization \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track adoption, usage, and value metrics across the product portfolio.
* Ensure products deliver measurable business impact, not just functionality.
* Identify opportunities to:
+ Simplify or consolidate products
+ Reduce technical or vendor dependency
+ Improve scalability and user experience

* Continuously refine product direction based on feedback and performance insights.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Analytics/Data‑centric leadership roles.
* Proven experience owning multiple products or domains in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data, analytics, reporting, and BI platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
* Experience leading or mentoring other Product Owners or equivalent roles.


**Preferred**
* Experience within a Chief Data Office, Analytics COE, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Databricks, Power BI, semantic models, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience modernizing legacy reporting or analytics platforms.
* Background in professional services or financial services environments.


**Leadership Behaviors \& Expectations**
* Thinks and acts portfolio‑first, not story‑by‑story.
* Brings clarity, structure, and discipline to ambiguity.
* Comfortable making—and defending—trade‑off decisions.
* Focused on outcomes, adoption, and trust, not just delivery.
* Acts as a role model for product ownership maturity.


**Role Relationships (Clarity of Accountability)**
* Lead Product Owner: Defines long‑term strategy, investment priorities, and value realization. Owns execution alignment, product standards, and delivery outcomes across a portfolio.
* Product Owners: Own day‑to‑day product execution and backlogs within specific domains.
* Program Managers: Own delivery coordination, milestones, and dependency management.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Lead Product Owner ensures CDO can
 **scale product‑led execution without chaos** 
 , reducing reliance on individual heroics while increasing predictability, trust, and impact across enterprise data and analytics investments.
