jobs.description:
Job Title: Digital Marketing Analyst

Department: Digital Marketing / Marketing

Location: Bengaluru

Reporting To: Head – Digital Marketing

Job Summary

The Digital Marketing Analyst will be responsible for analyzing digital marketing performance, tracking campaigns, generating actionable insights, and supporting data\-driven decision\-making. The role will work closely with the Digital Marketing, Admissions, Sales, CRM, and Creative teams to improve lead generation, campaign performance, conversion rates, and overall marketing ROI.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Campaign Performance \& Analytics

Monitor and analyze performance of Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other digital campaigns.

Track key metrics such as impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, CPL, conversions, conversion rate, and ROI.

Identify high\- and low\-performing campaigns, ad sets, keywords, audiences, and publishers.

Provide recommendations to optimize campaign budgets and performance.

2\. Lead \& Conversion Analysis

Analyze leads generated through different digital channels, publishers, landing pages, and campaigns.

Track the complete lead journey from Lead → Application → Application Paid → Submitted → Verified → Enrollment/Admission.

Identify lead quality, drop\-off points, and conversion trends.

Analyze source\-wise and campaign\-wise admission performance.

3\. CRM \& Data Analysis

Work with CRM platforms such as LeadSquared to extract and analyze lead and admission data.

Ensure accurate mapping of lead sources, campaigns, stages, and conversion data.

Identify data inconsistencies and coordinate with CRM/technical teams for resolution.

Maintain data hygiene and ensure reports are accurate and up to date.

4\. Reporting \& Dashboards

Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly digital marketing performance reports.

Create dashboards and MIS reports for management.

Provide insights on campaign spending, lead generation, lead quality, applications, admissions, and ROI.

Present key findings and recommendations to the Digital Marketing and Admissions leadership.

5\. Tracking \& Attribution

Monitor tracking mechanisms such as Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, pixels, and UTM parameters.

Ensure proper attribution of leads and conversions to the respective marketing channels.

Identify tracking gaps and coordinate with technical teams to resolve them.

6\. Landing Page \& Funnel Analysis

Analyze landing page performance, traffic, engagement, conversion rates, and drop\-offs.

Recommend improvements to landing pages and lead\-generation forms.

Conduct A/B testing analysis where applicable.

7\. Market \& Competitor Analysis

Track digital marketing trends and competitor campaigns.

Analyze competitor presence, messaging, keywords, offers, and digital strategies.

Provide insights to improve the university's digital marketing strategy.

Required Skills

Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

Good understanding of Google Ads and Meta Ads.

Strong knowledge of Google Analytics/GA4, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking.

Experience with CRM and lead\-generation platforms, preferably LeadSquared.

Advanced knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets.

Knowledge of dashboards and visualization tools such as Power BI, Looker Studio, or similar platforms.

Understanding of digital marketing KPIs and performance marketing.

Ability to analyze large datasets and identify meaningful trends.

Strong communication and presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's/Master's degree in Marketing, Business Analytics, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field.

2–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing Analytics, Performance Marketing Analytics, Business Analytics, or a similar role.

Experience in the education/EdTech sector is an advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Cost Per Lead (CPL)
* Lead\-to\-Application Conversion Rate
* Application\-to\-Admission Conversion Rate
* Cost Per Admission (CPA)
* Marketing ROI / ROAS
* Lead Quality
* Campaign Conversion Rate
* Data Accuracy \& Reporting Efficiency
* Landing Page Conversion Rate
* Channel/Publisher Performance

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be data\-driven, detail\-oriented, commercially aware, and comfortable working with large volumes of marketing and admissions data. The person should be able to convert raw campaign and CRM data into clear insights and actionable recommendations that help improve lead quality, admissions conversion, marketing efficiency, and ROI.

Pay: Up to ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: TPM + RGM Process & BI Analyst-Associate-Bangalore
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a TPM \+ RGM Process \& BI Analyst\- Experienced Associate, you will specialize in providing consulting services focused on customer\-related strategies and initiatives. You will analyze client needs, develop customer\-centric solutions, and offer guidance to help clients enhance their customer experience and drive business growth. Within our Commercial \& Service Excellence practice, you will focus on pricing strategies and profitability analysis, assessing customer profitability to optimize pricing strategies and maximize customer value.
   

  

 As an Associate, you will be driven by curiosity and contribute reliably to your team. You will adapt to working with diverse clients and team members, each presenting unique challenges and scope. Every experience is an opportunity to learn and grow, taking ownership and consistently delivering quality work that drives value for our clients and success as a team. You will build a brand for yourself, opening doors to more opportunities.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will apply a learning mindset, appreciate diverse perspectives, and commit to understanding how the business works. You will gather information from various sources to analyze facts and discern patterns, actively listen, ask questions, and clearly express ideas.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Assess current\-state trade promotion, rebate, accruals, deductions, claims, reporting and revenue management processes
   

  

 Define future\-state TPM/RGM operating models, business requirements, process controls and performance KPIs
   

  

 Support design, build and implementation of TPM, RGM and BI solutions aligned to client requirements
   

  

 Develop analytics and reporting capabilities across promotion planning, trade spend, forecast accuracy, accruals, payments and post\-event performance
   

  

 What You Must Have
   

  

 MBA in Sales / Marketing / Strategy/ Analytics from a premier B\-School is preferred but not required; in lieu of an MBA, equivalent experience in conjunction with an undergraduate degree in engineering, arts and economics, sciences or business from a Tier 1 college will be preferred
   

  

 Experience: 2\-5 years of prior relevant work experience in a Pricing / Sales/ Analytics Strategy role. Experience in management consulting and exposure to multinational environment will be an added bonus
   

  

 Candidates should demonstrate substantial experience and/or knowledge in the following areas:
   

  

 Trade Promotion Management (TPM): Customer/product master data, funds management, volume planning, promotion planning, trade promotion optimization, accruals, deductions, claims/payments, post\-event analytics and reporting.
   

  

 Revenue Growth Management (RGM): Net revenue management levers including price\-pack architecture, assortment/mix, promotion effectiveness, trade investment optimization, margin waterfall, revenue leakage and customer/channel performance.
   

  

 Process Design \& Business Analysis: As\-is/to\-be process mapping, requirements gathering, user stories, business rules, controls, KPI definition, testing/UAT support and stakeholder workshops.
   

  

 BI, Analytics \& Implementation: Data quality checks, dashboard/report design, KPI visualization and data\-driven insights; experience supporting TPM/RGM implementations from design through testing, deployment and adoption in the consumer markets/CPG space.
   

  

 What Sets You Apart
   

  

 Experience in TPM/RGM process transformation, trade promotions excellence, revenue management analytics or BI/reporting, preferably in consumer markets/CPG.
   

  

 Ability to gather requirements, document as\-is/to\-be processes, identify gaps, and translate business needs into functional specifications, process flows, and user stories.
   

  

 Strong analytical skills to collect, validate and interpret sales, volume, trade spend, accruals, deductions, claims, promotion and margin data to identify trends, leakage and performance improvement opportunities.
   

  

 Understanding of TPM/RGM financial concepts, including trade spend budgets, fund/liability accruals, deductions, claims settlement, gross\-to\-net/net revenue and margin impact.
   

  

 Experience researching and analyzing client, industry and technical matters; ability to problem\-solve, prioritize and manage multiple tasks for self and team.
   

  

 Strong written and oral communication skills, including client\-facing communication, workshop facilitation, and stakeholder management.
   

  

 Skilled with Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Exposure to TPM/RGM platforms such as SAP TPM, Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, Vistex, Anaplan or similar tools is a plus.
   

  

 Hands\-on expertise in BI and analytics tools such as Tableau, Power BI and Alteryx. Working knowledge of SQL is preferred; exposure to Python/R is a plus.
   

  

 Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams across sales, trade marketing, finance, revenue management and IT to align processes, data and report outputs.

 Consilio stands as the global leader in eDiscovery, document review, flexible legal talent, and legal advisory \& transformation consulting services. With its Consilio Complete suite of capabilities, the company empowers multinational law firms and corporations using innovative software, cost\-effective managed services, and deep legal and regulatory industry expertise .
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Our Salesforce Business Analyst plays a vital role as the "glue" in our project/task team. As our primary in\-house client advocate, the Business Analyst works closely with the stakeholders, technical team, and SMEs to lead and facilitate discussions to understand the client's needs, ask clarifying questions, discuss alternative scenarios, and turn them into requirements. Once the requirements are captured, the Business Analyst will work closely with our technical team (product owners, project manager, development manager, and technical lead) to help design and develop a solution to meet the client's requirements. Throughout the project's life, the Business Analyst's primary responsibility is representing the client and ensuring all deliverables align with the project's vision. This involves working with virtually every member of the project team, both internal and client\-facing, to facilitate communication, review the quality of deliverables, and ensure project success.
   

  

 To be successful as a Business Analyst, you should be a self\-driven and curious person with great attention to detail. Since the Business Analyst role is the "glue" for all projects, strong verbal and written communication skills are a priority, as the ability to work with a vast array of project team members. More importantly, one must have an interest in problem\-solving, a positive attitude, and a willingness to learn. Ultimately, working as a Business Analyst, you will learn to quickly break down and understand varying business processes, help to identify gaps or areas for improvement in those processes, and then work with our Senior Business Analyst or Application Owner to translate those into requirements via visual and written documentation. Because our clients span a wide range of internal organizational styles, no two projects are the same, and business Analyst bridge the gap between operational and technical resources.
